g.title: fast_decisions_layered
g.text: Tiers top-to-bottom: configuration → host platform → integration adapters → decision domain → backend port → cross-cutting → presentation & tooling → data stores → external systems
Arrows = uses / calls / reads. Solid coloured arrows are numbered by scenario (S1–S5, key at bottom). Dashed grey = composition or port realisation. Red = the only network egress.

g.title: cluster_t2
g.text: (modules/* are one-line shims onto these entry points)

g.title: cluster_t3
g.text: T3 · Application / domain layer — decision core

g.title: cluster_t4
g.text: (one port, four realisations; chosen by config, never substituted silently)

g.title: cluster_t5
g.text: (every event from T2–T4 passes through here)

g.title: cluster_t6
g.text: (local only, stdlib only; observatory has no Amplifier imports — enforced by tests/test_layering.py)

g.title: prof_shadow
g.text: mounts hook + workspace tool · orchestrator untouched
mode: shadow · backend: deterministic · role_router: on

g.title: prof_foundation
g.text: included by bundle.md · base tools, agents, context

g.title: adp_hook
g.text: observation only — always returns "continue" · never owns Policy

g.title: adp_tool
g.text: read / list only · path containment · size cap

g.title: prof_active
g.text: mode: active · backend: jev · allow_external_state: true

g.title: adp_orch
g.text: per-turn copies, no monkeypatching · sole owner of Policy

g.title: host_loop
g.text: session providers & tools · native approvals & hooks

g.title: dom_runtime
g.text: backend factory · owns shadow worker + recorder lifecycle

g.title: dom_service
g.text: eligibility → budgets → one batched ask() → thresholds → revalidation
Policy: mode · 3 consecutive / 12 per turn · 750 ms deadline · allowlist

g.title: dom_router
g.text: router.py · proposes model_role at delegate calls
records vs. what delegate resolved · never mutates

g.title: dom_inputs
g.text: per-contributor groups, conflicting group dropped whole
bounded snapshot ≤12 msgs, no system/thinking · fingerprint

g.title: ui_observatory
g.text: state file (pid · port · url) · optional browser open

g.title: adp_orch->host_loop
g.text: copies provider & tool maps per turn

g.title: xc_telemetry
g.text: telemetry.py · Emitter: one envelope per event
observation only — never an authorisation or audit guarantee

g.title: dom_shadow
g.text: joins proposal ↔ observed tool call → agreement
bounded drain (2 s) · sweeps unobserved at execution:end

g.title: port_backend
g.text: one batched request: action candidates + all judgment questions
abstention / invalid label / timeout ⇒ fall back to the generative provider

g.title: dom_contracts
g.text: DecisionBackend protocol · event names (used by every tier)

g.title: be_jev
g.text: typesafe_sdk · retries off · 5 s cooldown on failure

g.title: be_ollama
g.text: one-token classifier over HTTP · optional extra

g.title: be_unavailable
g.text: always falls back · never a scripted stand-in

g.title: ext_jev
g.text: reached only with backend: jev + allow_external_state

g.title: xc_privacy
g.text: privacy.py · scrub() secrets · safe_data() field allowlist
no raw requests recorded — hashes and fingerprints only

g.title: ui_viewer
g.text: server.py + static/ · EventIndex tails JSONL · http.server
token-auth /api/* · 250 ms poll · replay without a session

g.title: cli
g.text: cli.py · doctor · configure · demo · serve [--stop] · export
demo.py drives the real service with a synthetic loop

g.title: bench
g.text: bench/ · replay recorded telemetry · labelled suite · report

g.title: key
g.text: Shadow measurement (shipped default) — score "what would we have chosen" at tool:pre; never touches the turn
Active routing (bundles/active.yaml only) — substitute a prepared read-only tool call for an LLM turn, else pass through
Model-role router (P4) — shadow-only proposal of model_role at delegate calls
Observability — allowlisted events → JSONL → local viewer → browser
Offline tooling — replay and benchmark recorded telemetry
Hooks observe, never decide · the orchestrator alone owns Policy · confidence is never an approval token ·
